title: Hosted workspace bridge
responsibility: Adapt hosted project reads and human comments to the desktop workspace interface.

inputs.name: browserBridge.api
inputs.description: Same-site API client for project data and comments.

outputs.name: browserBridge
outputs.description: Bridge for shared project listing, snapshots, entities, source, images, threads, history and evidence, plus comment posting. Snapshots force writable, agents, planning and approval off; comments follow the server flag. Read refusals notify listeners on 401/403. Local project opening returns null and pending comments are empty.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects requests without a project and all plan/approval/provider/agent operations; API read and comment failures propagate.
